domain.description: The business's domain, as search_businesses or get_business gave it, like bikes.example.

service.description: The service's name, as get_business lists it, or its id from this tool's answer.

start.description: When your person wants it to start, from this tool's free times. Leave it out to see them first.

from.description: Without start: the first day to show free times for (today when left out).

party_size.description: How many people it is for, when that matters.

terms_sha.description: The confirm.terms_sha of the last answer, sent only after your person said yes to its summary.

contact.description: Needed with start: where the business answers.

email.description: Your person's email address, which they agreed to give this business for its answer.

name.description: The name your person wants the business to use.

consent.description: Needed with start: true only when your person agreed to give this business their email address.

language.description: The language your person wants the answer in, as a tag like en, pt or pt-BR.
